h.strategy: Use retrieved findings to classify settings as strong, weak, neutral or harmful, and to identify which settings can disconnect other parts from the outcome. Propose hypotheses only of two kinds. Self-conditioning: the edit's effect depends on the value it replaces, being more negative when that value is strong and more positive when it is empty or harmful. Disconnection: when the edited part cannot influence the outcome, its effect shrinks toward zero, so the direction is lower if the edit usually helps and higher if it usually hurts. Directions refer to the signed effect. For each hypothesis, state the edit's usual sign and a one-sentence mechanism. Cover varied edit fields and values. The critic should replace any hypothesis with an uncertain usual sign, competing effects or reliance on partial redundancy.

hyps.why: Filling an empty edge 5 reconnects node 2 to the output and gives a much larger gain than upgrading an already-present op.
A 1x1 to 3x3 upgrade only adds receptive field, a smaller gain than replacing none, pool or skip on that edge.
Replacing the strong direct-path skip with conv3x3 gains less, or even loses the easy gradient path, compared with replacing a weak or empty op.
With edge 0 empty, node 1 is cut off from the input, so adding a conv activates the whole node-1 branch and gives a large gain.
Pooling is a weak, information-losing op, so replacing it with conv3x3 gains more than replacing a competent op.
With edge 0 none, node 1 carries no signal, so edge 2 is dead and the conv edit gains almost nothing.
With the node-1 branch cut off, the direct input-to-output path carries more of the network, so strengthening edge 3 matters more.
With edge 0 none, node 1 receives no signal, so edge 4 carries nothing and its usual gain shrinks toward zero.
Edge 1 reaches the output only through edge 5, so when edge 5 is none the conv edit is disconnected and its gain vanishes.
Edge 2 feeds node 2, which reaches the output only via edge 5, so with edge 5 none the edit has no influence and its gain shrinks toward zero.
